scripts.deploy: npm run build:deploy:prod --workspace=@dialyrounds/client && wrangler deploy --env production
scripts.deploy:dev: npm run build:deploy:dev --workspace=@dialyrounds/client && wrangler deploy --env development
scripts.db:migrate:dev:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply dialyrounds --env development --remote
scripts.db:migrate:prod:remote: wrangler d1 migrations apply dialyrounds --env production --remote
scripts.db:seed:dev:remote: npm run db:seed:units:remote && npm run db:seed:mock:remote
